title: An X post timed exactly on the edge between two frozen scan intervals

tier1.note: Provider date search is inclusive at both ends to the second, so edge-post is returned by both scans.

notes: Use the JSON listing with since/until to emulate the two bounded scans. edge-post must be stored once and appear in exactly one window.

items.body: Labour Minister Teo Marsh just arrived at the port authority building. Talks with the dockworkers' union start at 3pm, his office says.
Talks have started. Union leader Ilse Brandt says the strike continues until there is a signed offer on the night-shift allowance.
Talks adjourned until tomorrow 9am. No offer on the table yet, both sides say.
